title: GitHub
intro: Let your agents read the code, issues and pull requests of the repositories you list, and, if you allow it, comment and open issues there. The agent reaches only those repositories, with the token you save here.
name: Name
tokenHelp: Starts with github_pat_. Give it access to the repositories below only. Reading needs Contents, Issues and Pull requests (read). Writing also needs Issues and Pull requests (write). It is kept sealed and never shown again.
tokenSaved: Saved. Type a token to replace it.
tokenShape: Use a fine-grained token: it starts with github_pat_.
reposHelp: One per line, as owner/name. {{count}} listed. The agent is refused any other repository, even if the token could reach it.

check.readWrite: {{repo}}: reachable, and the token can write.

noRepos: No repositories listed: the agent can read none.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: The agent can no longer reach these repositories, and the token saved with it is deleted. To set it up again you must enter the token again.

setup.title: How to make the token
setup.step1: On GitHub, open Settings, Developer settings, Fine-grained personal access tokens, and make a new token.
setup.step2: Under Repository access, choose Only select repositories and pick the ones you list here.
setup.step3: Under Permissions, give Read access to Contents, Issues and Pull requests. To let the agent write, give Read and write to Issues and Pull requests. Leave everything else off.

writeMode.label: What the agent may change on GitHub
writeMode.hint: Applies to comments, new issues, labels, closing issues and line comments on pull requests. The agent cannot merge, delete or push code.

note.off: Write access is off: this connection only reads.
note.propose: Each change waits in your approvals until you confirm it. Anything an agent writes is public to everyone who can see the repository.
note.auto: A chat of yours posts the change at once, without asking. Anything the agent writes is public to everyone who can see the repository. Runs without you present still wait for your confirmation.
